headline: Making credit decisions fast, and explainable enough to defend to a regulator
summary: Underwriters had risk scores, but a score alone isn't a decision. In banking, every approval or denial has to be justified in plain language and survive an audit. The bottleneck wasn't prediction. It was explanation.
highlights: Built an enterprise credit decisioning platform pairing real-time ML risk scoring with an LLM reasoning layer: streaming models score financial data while the LLM generates written, plain-language justifications an underwriter can read, challenge, and sign off on.

Grounded the LLM in retrieved context from actual financial sources and tracked groundedness scores and tool-call success rates in real time, so hallucinations showed up as metrics rather than surprises.
Led the design of the LangGraph workflow running each evaluation, architected with state checkpointing and retry logic to pause for human compliance review and resume exactly where it left off.

Led the evaluation suite and built an adversarial benchmark dataset from real-time data and edge-case interactions; integrated BERTScore, rubric-based evaluators, and hallucination detectors feeding MLflow dashboards with automated alerts before quality degradation reached downstream users.

Engineered scoring services in FastAPI operating under 120ms p95 latency, and built ReactJS/TypeScript dashboards providing executives and risk officers a live view of drift, accuracy, and underwriting throughput.
outcome: Automated loan approvals with audit-ready explanations, built to meet federal banking regulations, Model Risk Governance, and zero-trust security requirements.

headline: Turning thousands of policy documents into an assistant people actually trust
summary: Answers to everyday HR and policy questions were buried in thousands of dense manuals. People searched by hand or asked support staff the same questions over and over.
highlights: Spearheaded the build of an enterprise knowledge assistant on Claude 3.5 Sonnet, with LlamaIndex and Pinecone handling retrieval over dense policy manuals.

Engineered the ingestion layer with hierarchical chunking, semantic boundary splitting, and metadata tagging, ensuring retrieval returned the exact section of a technical manual instead of a vaguely related page.
Tuned prompts using dynamic few-shot examples and structured outputs, guaranteeing answers remained accurate, compliant, and consistent.
Treated the assistant as a product rather than a demo: continuously tracked deflection rate, answer accuracy, CSAT, and cost per query, while optimizing Recall@k and context faithfulness.

Audited retrieval logs with Python, Pandas, and SQL to identify knowledge base coverage gaps and reported them to stakeholders, converting assistant failures into an actionable backlog for improving documentation.
outcome: A working assistant that automated policy analysis and document Q&A, with measurable accuracy and cost.

headline: Fixing search for 60,000+ daily queries across four countries
summary: In a mobile app, a failed search is a lost customer, and too many searches ended in empty results. Customers typed a merchant name, an amount, or a vague intent, and the search couldn't make sense of it.
highlights: Scaled a hybrid search system combining semantic vector retrieval, fuzzy matching, and keyword search, serving 60,000+ daily queries across the US, UK, Australia, and Japan.

Proposed and engineered a Named Entity Recognition (NER) pipeline with spaCy, NLTK, and regex to extract amounts, merchants, dates, and intent from user inputs, deployed as a Dockerized microservice with sub-35ms response times.
Benchmarked retrieval against 1,200 GPT-labeled test queries and incorporated human-in-the-loop review to fine-tune retrieval thresholds.
Streamed query events between distributed microservices in real time using Apache Kafka.
Deployed LLMs to generate dynamic FAQ answers and contextual cards inside the mobile app, deflecting questions before escalating to live chat.
Contributed to shipping the production Typeahead API, handling 45,000+ daily autocomplete requests with low latency.
Launched an internal Docusaurus portal that established API standards and accelerated engineering onboarding.
outcome: +15% click-through rate, +3% digital self-service containment, 3,000+ previously empty queries resolved every month, and 45,000+ daily autocomplete requests served.

headline: Finding the signal in thousands of startup pitches
summary: Venture partners received far more startup ideas than anyone could read, and good ones were slipping through because screening was manual.
highlights: Clustered thousands of startup submissions using BERTopic, LDA, and transformer models to surface emergent market themes, accelerating investment thesis formulation.
Built an investment scoring model using XGBoost and LightGBM to rank submissions by venture potential.
Presented quantitative findings and explainability insights to stakeholders, translating algorithmic predictions into actionable criteria partners trusted.
Automated firm-wide KPI dashboards in Tableau and Power BI, displaying live category distributions, founder signals, and scoring metrics.
Established data validation checks and QA protocols alongside partners, product managers, and analysts to reliably process messy, unstructured pitch data.
outcome: 2x higher investment conversion rate and 50% less manual reporting.

headline: Building the data backbone for financial systems that can't afford mistakes
summary: Large volumes of financial data from ERP platforms had to be processed accurately and quickly. Slow batch jobs and silent data errors meant delays, and risk, in regulatory audits.
highlights: Built Java and Python automation pipelines to extract, transform, and validate financial data, cutting end-to-end processing time by 40% with zero data loss across regulatory audits.
Designed scalable microservices connected by ActiveMQ for reliable asynchronous messaging across enterprise business units.
Automated eCommerce integrations using MuleSoft and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, removing manual deployment friction.
Optimized SQL queries, indexes, and schemas in MySQL and PostgreSQL alongside Redis caching, cutting query execution times by 40%.
Added automated validation, sanity checks, and error logging across ETL batch jobs, proactively catching schema anomalies and data drift.
outcome: Faster pipelines, 40% faster queries, and a reliability record that stood up to audits.
